summary: Iteration 5 validated the Round Recap Card + Tip Streaks feature across backend + mobile + desktop. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_recap_and_streaks.py (LIVE-DATA SAFE, 18/18 pytest cases PASS, 7.1s). Uses ephemeral finals round (POST /api/rounds -> R15 'TEST Final <tag>'), adds 3 matches with 6 distinct teams, registers 3 TEST_recap_* players, each submits tips BEFORE results, admin PUTs home-wins on all 3, then verifies recap + leaderboard, then cleans up via DELETE /api/rounds/15 and DELETE /api/admin/players/{id} for each. Rounds 1-14 and Mel BV untouched (confirmed before + after: rounds count=14, max=14, no TEST_ players in leaderboard). GET /api/rounds/15/recap returned {available:false} before winners, then once complete: for P0 (perfect) correct=3/total=3 bonus=1 points=4 won_round=true round_top_points=4, rank=1, prev_rank=1 (zero-point ladder before has everyone tied rank 1), best_pick{match_id,team_id,opponent_id,share=33,backers=1} = m0 (P0 is lone HOME backer); for P1/P2 correct=2 bonus=0 points=2 won_round=false best_pick.share=100 backers=3 (shared m1); admin recap returned available=true but rank=null and prev_rank=null (admin excluded). GET /api/leaderboard rows all contain streak + best_streak ints (best_streak>=streak, no mongo _id leak); given rounds 1-14 have NO decided matches, the finals-round matches are the only decided ones, so P0 streak=3 best_streak=3, P1 streak=2 best_streak=2, P2 streak=2 best_streak=2 as expected. GET /api/round-winners lists the test final with points=4 and single winner P0. 401 enforced for unauthenticated recap; 404 for unknown round number. Frontend (login testIDs auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-button correctly used): Seeded a separate 'UITest Player' + round 15 'UI Final' with 2 home-wins; logged in on mobile 390x844 -> round chip 15 (data-testid=round-chip-15) tappable -> RoundRecapCard rendered with testID round-recap-card at top of a complete round only; recap-points='3', recap-rank='1st', recap-movement='Held 1st' (prev_rank==rank==1, uses remove icon), recap-best-pick shows 'Best pick: Lalor · Beat Moonee Valley · only 100% of players tipped them' (sole player so share=100), recap-round-winner trophy pill visible. Ladder tab: ladder-streak-{user_id} badge visible with flame + '2'; meta text 'best streak 2' present in podium + row. Desktop 1366x800: centred column confirmed - exactly one div with maxWidth=720px, alignSelf=center, border-left/right=1px, computed width=720, left=323 (symmetrically centred). Switching back to 390 kept mobile layout intact (no horizontal borders at mobile width). All UI seed data cleaned up (DELETE round 15 -> 200, DELETE player -> 200, verified 14 rounds remain and 0 TEST_/UITest players in ladder). The pre-existing /app/backend/tests/test_round_recap.py was LIVE-DATA UNSAFE (set winners on R1+R2); replaced by pytest.skip(allow_module_level=True) with a note pointing to the new file.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py compute_standings re-runs the full standings computation twice from round_recap (once at upto=n, once at upto=max(prev_rounds)); fine for 14 rounds + ~2 players but will scale O(rounds*users*tips) per recap request. Consider memoising per request or passing a single cached matches list.

server.py round_recap: when prev_rounds is empty (true for round 1), prev_rank is set to None – the frontend handles this as 'Debut at Nth'. Admin uses prev_rank_if_prev_rounds_else_None = None, which still renders 'Not on ladder' because rank is also None. Correct behaviour but worth a one-line doc comment.
RoundRecapCard: move==0 renders 'Held Nth' with a 'remove' Ionicon in onSurfaceTertiary – low-contrast grey could read as disabled; consider the same brand accent as 'Debut'. Minor.

StreakBadge in ladder.tsx hides when row.streak<2 which is correct, but a user whose current streak is 1 but best_streak>=2 still shows 'best streak N' in the meta text – no inconsistency, just a design choice to document.

pytest.ini uses -n 2 --dist loadscope: because loadscope distributes CLASSES across workers, any new test file that groups tests in multiple classes AND creates/deletes a shared 'last finals round' will have teardown races (observed: two workers each created a round, one teardown saw its round was no longer the 'last' and got 400). Current file uses module-level functions so loadscope keeps them on one worker – future additions should either stay module-level or use xdist_group markers.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_round_recap.py (replaced body with module-level pytest.skip; deprecation note)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (recap card fields, round-winner pill, streak badge, best-streak meta, desktop 720px frame, mobile 390 intact)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create 1 ephemeral finals round + 3 matches + 3 TEST_recap_* players + 9 tips + 3 match winners per module run, all cleaned up in the fixture's finally block (DELETE /api/rounds/{n} cascades matches+tips; DELETE /api/admin/players/{id}). UI testing additionally seeded a separate 'UI Final' round + 'UITest Player' with 2 home-wins; cleaned up manually after the Playwright run (verified rounds count returned to 14 and no TEST_/UITest players left in /api/leaderboard).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round-Recap + Streak tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_recap_and_streaks.py – safe to re-run anytime, no live-data mutation. The old /app/backend/tests/test_round_recap.py is pytest.skip at module level; do not re-enable – it mutates live R1/R2 winners. UI testIDs: Tips tab RoundRecapCard = round-recap-card / recap-points / recap-rank / recap-movement / recap-best-pick / recap-round-winner (only shown when round.complete is True); Ladder tab StreakBadge = ladder-streak-{user_id} (shown only when streak>=2). Login testIDs are auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button (NOT email-input/password-input). Desktop frame uses maxWidth:720 + alignSelf:center + borderLeftWidth/borderRightWidth:1 only when Platform.OS==='web' in _layout.tsx. Round chip testID pattern is round-chip-{number} (e.g. round-chip-15).
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Both backend endpoints and both frontend components match the spec from the review request exactly: /api/rounds/{n}/recap returns all 14 fields, best_pick selects the LOWEST share among the user's correct picks, admin recap has rank=null, prev_rank is computed from compute_standings(upto=max(prev_rounds)), /api/leaderboard rows include streak + best_streak with the kickoff/round/order ordering (wrong/missed/draw resets streak), RoundRecapCard only renders when d.available (via useRoundRecap enabled flag) AND is only mounted when r.complete is True in index.tsx, StreakBadge gates on row.streak>=2, and desktop web is a 720px centred column (mobile 390 unchanged).
